description: LLM model configuration for the chatbot two-model pipeline and statement categorization

notes.primary_model: Merchant name cleaning (pass 1 & arbiter) + chatbot intent parser + transaction categorization.
notes.secondary_model: Merchant name cleaning (pass 2 ensemble). Set to empty string to disable ensemble cleaning.
notes.financial_analysis_model: Chatbot step 2: conversational financial advice and multi-turn responses.
notes.memory_model: Optional persistent multi-turn memory model (e.g. 'hermes3'). When set, handles the conversational layer so context accumulates across turns without re-sending the full history from the client. Falls back to financial_analysis_model if empty.
